answer.explanation: Removing the `//go:generate mockery` directive from `staging/src/k8s.io/component-helpers/nodedeclaredfeatures/types.go` does not impact any other files in the repository. Key reasons: (1) There is no `.mockery.yaml` configuration file in the nodedeclaredfeatures directory or any parent directory within component-helpers, so mockery had no configuration to generate mocks from. (2) There are no mockery-generated files (identified by the '// Code generated by mockery' header) anywhere in the nodedeclaredfeatures package. (3) The file `staging/src/k8s.io/component-helpers/nodedeclaredfeatures/testing/mocks.go` is a manually written file (it lacks the 'Code generated by mockery' header) and is not affected by the removal of the generate directive. (4) All exported types, interfaces, functions, and struct fields remain identical, so no files importing the package are affected.
